title: Kristen Cabrera: a portfolio that reads like a diary
note: The home is her name set enormous in a pointed-pen script (two lines, black, overlapping the bio), on a liquid-chrome background of soft grey with horizontal bands of pink and mint light, framed by a thin green edge. Under it a justified bio in a condensed grotesk, with one word (madrid) in blackletter and her handle in italic serif. A small pink glass pill with a four-point star at each corner says what she last listened to and when (live from a music API). Language switch as outlined italic pills, a polaroid below. Worth reusing: one huge script name, one live sentence about right now in a starred glass pill, and a different face for each kind of word. Her fan sites (pinned separately) each take one of these moves further.
